_comment: Real published housing documents, used only as a formatting probe for pypdf
extraction and clause splitting — there are no violation labels here, and no
precision or recall is computed from them.
Chosen because they are genuinely real (people sign these) and genuinely
public: two are US federal forms, which are public-domain government works,
and three are published by public universities. No private lease, and no
individual's signed agreement, is used anywhere in this repo.
The files themselves are gitignored: they are third-party documents whose
canonical home is the URL. Run: python -m evaluation.eval_real_formats --fetch

documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
documents.note: The closest thing to a canonical real residential lease in the public domain. Federal, so it is not written against RCW 59.18 — useful as a false-positive probe.

documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
documents.kind: lease addendum, not a standalone lease
documents.note: Attached to real Housing Choice Voucher leases. Included partly as a gate probe: an addendum is not a lease.
Washington, and long-form: hundreds of enumerated provisions. The document that disproved the '60 clauses is not a lease' assumption.
